During a tricky situation at my appointment, Annissa could not have been more compassionate and kind. She is a true professional and I would highly recommend her!!! It's a beautiful salon as well!

WOW! 518 beauty room is a HIDDEN GEM. I needed a facial, dermaplane, and a brow wax and tint all without breaking the bank before my honeymoon. Alexis did all of that and more!! She gave me one of the best experiences of my life for 140$. She even included some free samples. Very personable and very knowledgeable. I would not recommend anywhere else in the 518 more than her and the 518 beauty room. Clean and professional, but also homey and nonthreating. Truly worth every penny.

I had an amazing experience at 518 Beauty Room! It was my first time getting a lash lift, which I'd wanted to get forever and it went really well! Catelyn was very kind, answered all my questions, and just overall made the experience comfortable! I will 100% be a returning client and I'll also be looking into all the other wonderful services they offer! UPDATE (Nov 2025) - I literally can NOT recommend this place and Catelyn McCann ENOUGH!! I’ve been seeing her the past few months for lashes, waxing, and now my skincare!! I’m literally glowing!!

Annissa is my lash tech! She's the best and always leaving me feel so beautiful! It's never awkward either, like sometimes you'll have a tech that's awkward and doesn't talk and Annissa never makes me feel awkward or uncomfortable. The first day I went was like we've known each other for longer.
Annissa does great work with lashes. I am someone who likes the fox eye, and she nailed it every time.

So happy I came here!  Annissa was my lash tech and she was amazing! I highly recommend 518 Beauty Room. I was most impressed with the ease of scheduling and their professionalism. I scheduled a facial with Catelyn and feel I hit the jackpot. I recently had the pleasure of getting eyelash extensions by Elizabeth Cody, and I must say, the service was absolutely amazing! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and professionalism. Libby is incredibly skilled, taking the time to ensure that every lash was perfectly placed. Catelyn is an *INCREDIBLE* find for all of your wax needs! This salon is very cute, cozy, and clean. Grateful to have these amazing ladies and this location so conveniently located in downtown GF.
Eyebrow wax great. Facial delightful

Update: I’m still a recurring client of Catelyn 3 years later!! I don’t trust anyone else with my skin or brows. She is the brown queen of the 518 area!!  She is  the best in the business! She is very thorough and is does a consistent job every time. She has a service for everyone! Definitely try her out! You’ll want to keep coming back!

Got pregnant in January and treated myself to my first ever facial. It was a joy, so relaxing and professional. My face felt so clean and rejuvenated afterward. I would definitely book the hour long facial next time. Catelyn was wonderful, I would highly recommend her services!

@pamperedbyCatelyn is so sweet and professional. I go every 6-8 weeks for a lash lift and tint. Somehow she makes this extra relaxing with a warm lavender weighted satchel on your chest and super comfortable table!

Catelyn is AMAZING! She’s super personable and sweet. Always helps with questions. I’ve been to her for many appointments full of laughs and self care. I’ve done waxing, lashes, and facials with her…all have been wonderful.  She’s a perfectionist who always makes sure you get her best work and leave with a smile. From the first appointment and since it’s felt like we have been friends for 20 years. Thanks Catelyn! ❤️

I had a couple Brazilian waxes done by Catelynn. She did such an amazing job and made me feel so comfortable through the entire experience. I had no hair when wearing a bikini for a long time and was very satisfied. 10/10 recommend and will be continuing to get waxed by Catelynn !!!!

Catelyn is an absolute skin care queen!! During my facial she asked me questions about my skin care routine and helped me find the right products to help with my concerns. My skin has never felt or looked better!!!  My eyebrows are always on point too!
Kim is a great hair stylist. She is very knowledgeable about locs and healthy hair. My loc Retwist was so crispy!!! I highly recommend her.
